packageRules.description: Let fresh registry releases age so compromised versions get yanked first
pyproject.toml requires Python <3.13; applies to Docker tags and requires-python
Local Postgres matches prod RDS and Valkey tracks ElastiCache 8.2 as closely as images allow; approve on the dashboard when bumping iac/
Devcontainer tooling images are bumped by hand; aws-cli is also used by minio-init, so both copies stay in step
iac/ is applied by hand and CI does not run Terraform, so its PRs would pass untested
